description: The three enemy teams you can fight right now in the Fosse, as compositions only (name/type/preset/rarity/level — never stats), plus your team (with ids and progression: xp, xp_next = level×100), the bet table (bronze 5 / silver 12 / gold 25 FA), payout_mult (1.7), free_fights_remaining and daily caps. The three belong to your current floor (`stage`), and `stages` lists the five floors: unlocked/current, clears (clears_needed = 3 wins open the next floor), reward_multiplier (1 / 1.4 / 2 / 2.8 / 4 — floor 3 pays exactly twice floor 1, the last floor 4x) and payouts per tier. A floor's enemy power is frozen when you unlock it, so growing clears it faster instead of farming it. Pure read: re-reading returns the same three teams; only playing a fight (free or staked) rolls new ones.
